## How it was checked

- [ ] `claude plugin validate .`
- [ ] `claude plugin test .`
- [ ] Test added or updated for the behavior change (assertion flipped once to confirm it fails)
- [ ] User-visible change noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] README, README.zh-cn.md and `docs/` updated together if a setting, key or hint changed
- [ ] Fixtures and examples use synthetic data only
